stops.name: Ásbyrgi
stops.detail: The Jökulsárgljúfur National Park is located in northern Iceland on the west side of the river Jökulsá á Fjöllum and extends from the horseshoe-shaped canyon Ásbyrgi in the north to the most powerful waterfall in Europe, Dettifoss, in the south.

stops.name: Hljóðaklettar
stops.detail: The area is referred to as Hljóðaklettar (Echo Rocks).
